payload.title: HL-60 differentiation and viability under repurposed retinoid exposure
payload.abstract: Retinoid repurposing in myeloid malignancy is well established and the HL-60 line remains the standard model. Cells were exposed to four retinoids for 96 hours and viability was measured by trypan blue exclusion alongside differentiation markers. All-trans retinoic acid gave an IC50 of 2.7 micromolar for viability while inducing CD11b expression at substantially lower concentrations. Isotretinoin was roughly five-fold less potent. The cells are promyelocytic leukaemia in origin and were maintained in suspension culture. No hepatic cell type was included in the experimental design.
